target: ARM32 vendor HIDL service on verified Android12 API32 firmware
scope: Decoder-only 1.14.16 core on API32 with cached internal copy buffers, read-only DMA synchronization, standard work flow, original full-precision/HDR contracts and stop/drain ownership repair. Existing HIDL registry, secure and encoder routes remain firmware-backed.
mpp: Existing newer source-built MPP 1.1.0 compatibility pair retained; 2024 SDK MPP evaluated privately and not bundled.
kernel: Original 5.10.66 built-in Rockchip VPU driver, no kernel replacement or clock changes.
rollback: codec2_sdk_next off restores the separately packaged 1.14.3 SIMD core; codec2_sdk off restores the legacy backend.

local_av1_extension.quality: AV1 native display output explicitly retains bitdepth; no ten-to-eight fallback
local_av1_extension.route: consumer-usage selected native NV15 display or validated P010 texture output

local_av1_afbc_extension.scope: RK3588, native composer Surface, original eight/ten-bit precision, width divisible by 64; honors client FBC-disable
local_av1_afbc_extension.layout: lossless AFBC; completed-frame crop for filter-dependent top padding
local_av1_afbc_extension.fallback: linear NV15; explicit P010, texture and CPU consumers retain existing paths
